name: Tau estimated at eight gated spots, floored forever
non_visual_rationale: An estimated pooling strength is arithmetic over stored numbers. No template, string, style or route is touched, and the published surface is byte-identical: at launch no spot has passed the gates, so the estimator never runs and the hand-set prior stands. U1-U8 and a Vera walk are N/A.
criteria_delivered: 1. With eight gated spots wildly disagreeing, each stored difference sits nearer its own mornings than the prior of 6 leaves it. On the fixture the estimator lands at tau ~= 4.0 against a prior of 6, so every spot keeps a quarter more of its own reading.

2. No stored difference reaches its own mornings exactly, and none of them reaches even as far as the permanent floor of 2 would allow. The second half is the load-bearing one: it is what distinguishes an estimated tau from one clamped to its floor.

3. Below eight gated spots the hand-set prior stands unchanged, pinned exactly rather than compared loosely, in a run whose only difference is that the eighth spot's mornings came from four people instead of six.
scope_note: The accepted roadmap names hierarchy.ts, constants.ts and the unit laws. correction-file.ts was also touched, and had to be: the estimated tau has to reach the one place that shrinks a spot toward its parent, and that call site lives there. TAU_FLOOR was landed at 03-02, beside the laws that rest on it; this step gave it its production reader, which is what that contract said would happen.
design_decisions_not_stated_upstream: EIGHT GATED SPOTS IS COUNTED PER (source, lead_bucket) KEY, NOT PER RUN. 06 section 5.3 says 'once >= 8 spots pass the gate' without naming the scope. Every other quantity in this lane -- n, reporters, se, b, the parent, the similarity family -- is per key, and a tau estimated from spots proven at a different lead time would be describing a different population. The per-key reading is also the stricter one, so it delays the switchover rather than rushing it.

sigma_within IS ESTIMATED AS mean(se^2 * n), NOT BORROWED FROM SIGMA_EFF. The prior of 6 was derived from sigma_within ~= 0.42 m; SIGMA_EFF.height is 0.48 m, and 0.48^2/0.17^2 is about 8, not 6. Borrowing the constant would silently redefine what tau means. se^2 * n estimates the single-sample variance from the spot's own mornings, which is the quantity the formula asks for. One unit test exists solely to tell those two apart.

THE ESTIMATOR READS se_gate, NOT se_sample. 06 section 5.3's formula says mean(se^2) without saying which. se_gate is the floored form the correction file publishes, so a reader can recompute the estimate by hand from the stored files; it also cannot be driven to zero by coordinated agreement, which would otherwise inflate the between-spot variance and buy a loud minority less pooling than it earned. HONEST COST, stated: where the physical noise floor binds -- every sample identical -- mean(se_gate^2 * n) degenerates to (0.5 * sigma_eff)^2 and is a floor artifact rather than a measurement. This is why the acceptance fixture gives each spot real morning-to-morning spread instead of identical residuals.

SPOTS THAT AGREE LEAVE tau AT THE PRIOR. When var(b_own) is no larger than the noise already explains, sigma_between^2 comes out at or below zero: the between-spot variance is not identifiable from that data. The prior stands, rather than a division by something at or below zero putting an infinity or a NaN into a stored correction file. Proven by mutation Q3 below, where removing the guard produces exactly that NaN.

THE GATED SET AND tau ARE BOTH DECIDED IN THE COLLAPSED PASS, at the prior, and the final verdict is then re-taken at the estimated tau. Same two-pass shape 03-03 established, for the same reason: the gate certifies a spot's own evidence, and a fixed-point loop over a threshold can oscillate.
acceptance: Two examples over the same eight spots, driving the real runLearningFitOnce port. The fixture is built to make the estimator observable rather than merely present: eight spots centred at 0.7 m so every one clears the significance gate, spread +/- 0.36 m so the between-spot variance is large, and each spot's twelve mornings disagreeing with each other by +/- 0.45 m so se_sample sits above the physical noise floor and the within-spot variance is measured rather than floored. Those numbers put the estimate at tau ~= 4.0, strictly between the floor of 2 and the prior of 6, which is the only region where all three criteria are separable. THE ORACLE IS A CORRIDOR COMPUTED BY HAND from the two declared constants: each stored difference must sit strictly nearer its own mornings than tau = 6 leaves it, AND strictly further from them than tau = 2 would allow. The second example changes exactly one thing -- the eighth spot's mornings come from four people instead of six -- and pins every stored difference to the prior's arithmetic.
unit_law: Four tests in tests/unit/learning-hierarchy-laws.test.ts against spotTauFrom, whose signature is its port. Three properties: (1) below the switchover the hand-set prior stands, however the proven spots look; (2) the returned strength is always finite and never below the floor, generated from a union of free-form sets and DELIBERATELY DRAWN agreeing sets, because the unidentifiable branch is where an infinity would be born and a free generator lands on it too rarely to be evidence; (3) spreading the proven spots further apart never raises the pooling strength -- research 09 section 17.4's claim that a correctly fitted hierarchy stops pooling on its own, as a monotonicity invariant rather than a restated formula. The generator for (3) builds spots at guaranteed separation so both the original and the widened set stay on the identifiable branch; without that the property would fail legitimately across the guard boundary, where the prior of 6 sits above an estimate near zero. One example-based test pins the estimator's exact value against arithmetic worked out in its own comment, and exists solely to catch the units mistake.
test_budget: Behaviours: (1) the switchover at eight, (2) the permanent floor, (3) pooling steps aside as spots disagree, (4) the estimator's units. Four behaviours, budget 8. Delivered 6: 2 acceptance examples and 4 unit tests.
red_evidence: The acceptance example was written first and run against the 03-03 body: RED with AssertionError on "spot-0's stored difference sits 0.11999999999999994 from its own mornings, no nearer than the prior's 0.12: pooling did not step aside" -- the stored value was sitting exactly where the hand-set prior put it, to fourteen decimal places, because no estimator existed. Its companion example (the prior standing at seven proven spots) passed on arrival, correctly: that is today's behaviour and the example exists to keep it.
falsifiability_evidence: Five controlled mutations, each planted alone, each reverted, each verified byte-for-byte against a snapshot. (Q1) the whole method-of-moments block replaced by a return of TAU_FLOOR at eight spots -- the plausible shortcut, and the one a corridor stated only against the prior would have missed: the acceptance example fails on 'tau was clamped to its floor rather than estimated', at 0.05142857142857138 against the floor's 0.05142857142857142. (Q2) the floor removed: the floor property fails with a pooling strength of 0. (Q4) the switchover made 7 instead of 8: the property and the seven-spot acceptance example both fail. THE TWO THAT SURVIVED THE FIRST ROUND, recorded because they are the real finding of this step. (Q3) the unidentifiable guard deleted: passed everything. The floor property could only catch it by generating eight or more spots that agree, and a free generator did not reach that shape in 50 runs. Fixed by drawing agreeing sets deliberately; the mutation now fails with 'the pooling strength came out NaN, which would put an infinity or a NaN straight into a stored correction file'. (Q5) sigma_within^2 replaced by SIGMA_EFF's 0.48^2 -- the units trap: passed everything, because 2.88 and 3.125 both sit inside the acceptance corridor. Fixed by adding the one example that pins the estimator's exact value; the mutation now fails with 'the estimator said 2.8800000000000003 where the method of moments says 0.25 / 0.08 = 3.125'. Both gaps were found by mutation and closed before this step was committed, which is what the mutation pass is for.
test_repair: tests/unit/learning-hierarchy-laws.test.ts's cold-start property (landed 03-02) failed during this step on a fast-check seed that produced a parent of negative zero: node:assert/strict compares numbers by SameValue, which reports -0 and 0 as different, while `===`, JSON, arithmetic and every reader of a wave height say they are the same number. At a parent of -0 the shrink computes `0 * raw + 1 * -0`, and IEEE addition makes that +0 -- correct arithmetic. The TEST's equality was repaired (both sides normalised through `value + 0`), not the claim and not the production code; `git diff HEAD -- src/learning/shrink.ts` was confirmed empty, so the property exercises code this step never touched. This is the 'the test itself has a bug' case, and it is recorded rather than quietly fixed.
gates_run: npm run typecheck exit 0. Full suite at --maxWorkers=4 exit 0, 474 passed across 90 files, up from 468 across 89, which is exactly this step's 6 new tests. npm run build exit 0.
known_flake: A second load-sensitive flake surfaced once and did not repeat: tests/unit/staleness-flip.test.ts copies the project to a temp directory and shells out to a full `npm run build`, and that nested build died on a vite dependency-optimizer race (ENOTEMPTY renaming node_modules/.vite/deps_temp_* to deps). Same family as 02-01's record: a test that runs a whole build inside a parallel suite. It passed on re-run. Flagged, not fixed: the file belongs to another lane.
